name: phishguard
description: PhishGuard — one-command development setup: FastAPI backend (internal :8000) + Next.js frontend (user-facing :3001).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:frontend: wait-on -t 60000 http-get://127.0.0.1:8000/health && cd safelink-frontend && npm run dev -- -p 3001
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.start:frontend: wait-on -t 60000 http-get://127.0.0.1:8000/health && cd safelink-frontend && npm run start -- -p 3001
